items.title: Carmen Leggio interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: The guitar player that did a beautiful album called “Ohio Boss Guitar” and Connie Kay was on it.

ctx.x: The guitar player that did a beautiful album called “Ohio Boss Guitar” and Connie Kay was on it. And he just — he didn’t want to play any solos, he just sat back there and swung. So I could tell the difference. But I can’t go up and say hey, get it. I can’t do that. I don’t like to hurt anybody’s feelings. But drummers are important to me, very important. If I don’t have the right drummer, I’m in trouble.
Did you bring some stuff that you wanted to talk about or show us?
